name: OpenAI Codex app-server documentation
findings: App-server is the bidirectional integration used by rich Codex clients.
A client initializes a connection, starts or resumes a thread, starts a turn, and consumes streamed notifications.
turn/steer appends input to an in-flight turn without creating a new turn.

name: OpenAI Codex app-server open-source protocol README
findings: turn/steer requires threadId, expectedTurnId, and input and returns the accepting turnId.
Steering rejects a missing/stale active turn and non-steerable review or manual-compaction turns.
clientUserMessageId can correlate the resulting user-message item.

name: OpenAI Codex non-interactive mode
findings: codex exec is the documented pipeline and CI interface.
--json streams output events as JSONL.
Piped stdin is initial prompt/context; the page does not define a later-turn stdin protocol.

name: Anthropic Claude Code CLI reference
findings: --input-format supports stream-json in print mode.
--replay-user-messages acknowledges messages received through stream-json stdin.
The CLI can keep one process connected to a realtime input stream.

name: Anthropic Agent SDK streaming input mode
findings: Streaming input mode supports a persistent interactive session.
It preserves context across multiple messages and supports queued messages.

name: JSON-RPC 2.0 specification
findings: Request IDs correlate responses while notifications intentionally omit responses.
A small client must distinguish requests, responses, errors, and notifications.

name: Node.js child_process documentation
findings: child_process.spawn exposes writable stdin and readable stdout/stderr streams.
It is sufficient to host a local JSONL app-server transport without a new runtime dependency.

name: Hive Mind issue #1708 case study
findings: Introduced --auto-input-until-mergeable and the queue-versus-stream policy.
Identified uncommitted changes, CI, comments, and metadata as live-input sources.

name: Hive Mind issue #2007 case study
findings: Claude and Agent use live input while Codex remains on restart/resume fallback.
Previously identified app-server turn/steer as the required future Codex transport.

name: Hive Mind issue #814 streaming-input experiments
findings: Repository experiments exercise multiple Claude stream-json user messages and concurrent I/O.
The experiments distinguish queued feedback from immediate interruption semantics.
